rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for continued existence or staying alive.

example.english: Survival on this deserted island is really difficult.
example.traditional: 喺呢個荒島，生存落去真係唔容易。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 fong1 dou2 sang1 cyun4 lok6 heoi3 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6

rows.note: Use this for survival as a practical aim, especially in phrases about survival plans, skills, or equipment.

example.english: You definitely need to bring this survival kit.
example.traditional: 呢個求生工具包一定要帶埋。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kau4 sang1 gung1 geoi6 baau1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daai3 maai4

rows.note: Use this specifically in sports when a team is trying to avoid relegation.

example.english: If we win this match, we have a good chance of survival.
example.traditional: 我哋今場贏波就有望護級。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 coeng4 jing4 bo1 zau6 jau5 mong6 wu6 kap1
